rejections.name: Service Type
rejections.reason: The wiring diagram for part 00-10050-354 lists "50A Service = Sleep Mode" among its Program Options, which is how the panel is programmed to behave on a 50 A service rather than a service type of the panel.

rejections.name: Service Current
rejections.reason: The wiring diagram for part 00-10050-626 lists "50A Service = Disable" among its Program Options and shows the panel set for a 30 A service, so it is not a service current.

rejections.name: Current Limit
rejections.reason: The wiring diagram lists "50A Service = Sleep Mode" and "GEN =45A Current Limit" under Program Options, so 45 A is the generator current limit set for this coach, not a current limit of the unit.
